review_scope: Read-only independent review of minimal fixture/test repair against immutable issued csr11

findings.check: Empty ACK power default at adapter boundary
findings.evidence: HOP Layer.makeAck and makeControlAck intentionally emit TxPowerDbm=[]. Production MacHopSimulation.enqueueMac defaults empty power immediately before MAC.enqueue. The repaired fixture enqueue now applies the same rule using the pinned plan.power_dbm (+33 dBm). MAC Layer transmit uses scalar cellfun results for powers, so the formerly empty ACK caused the observed failure.
The single assignment is guarded by isempty(frame.TxPowerDbm). Nonempty caller-supplied powers, rates, ordering, frame identity, queue semantics and production algorithms are unchanged.

CaseResults template and each case result both add ErrorStack. Success initializes a zero-element struct with file/name/line fields; catch retains the authentic MException.stack. No runtime error is suppressed or converted into completion.

Existing everyBoundedCaseCompletes additionally requires scalar observed 128 kbps / +33 dBm TX rows, a real gateway ACK transmission in each case, and empty error stacks for completed cases. Total selected test names remains 52 (8 TestReplayContract methods).

findings.check: Return gate compatible with additional field
findings.evidence: Unchanged analyzer validates required case fields and their values without demanding exact CaseResults key membership; the extra ErrorStack field is allowed. Completed false or nonempty ErrorIdentifier/ErrorMessage still rejects the evidence. Source and candidate bindings are independently enforced.
All 225 accepted sources, including 124 MATLAB files, remain byte-identical in csr11r. Only the two named new Tranche 11 MATLAB files differ from csr11.
